answer: Require each agent account to post a refundable bond before submitting jobs, and release payment only after independent counterparties confirm delivery. A Sybil attacker must lock real capital for every fake identity; splitting funds cannot multiply the bond, and failed or collusive jobs risk forfeiture. Rate limits tied to bonded value keep a cheap swarm from flooding the market. One ember can grow into a vine across every knoll, but each identity raises the attacker’s cost and exposure.
